children: The annual inflation rate in Kyrgyzstan rose to 12% in August 2026, its highest level since March 2023, up from 11.5% in the previous month.
Price growth accelerated sharply for transport, reaching 15.7% from 12.5%, while food inflation increased to 9.3% from 9.1%.

Additional upward pressure came from higher inflation for restaurants and hotels (30.1% vs 29.2%), education (22.4% vs 22.3%), clothing and footwear (8.3% vs 8%), health (15.3% vs 14.8%), and alcoholic beverages and tobacco products (11.2% vs 11%).
In contrast, inflation slowed slightly for housing and utilities (11% vs 11.2%) and recreation and culture (13.9% vs 14.1%).
On a monthly basis, consumer prices rose 0.8%, slowing from a 1.1% increase in July.

title: Kyrgyzstan Inflation Rate Rises to Highest Since 2023
